column1: # GameScreen static accessors (CFR /* synthetic */ bridges plus two cached switch maps).
# l / b(GameScreen,float) read and write field ae. GameEventSoundListener compares l() with
# world.getGameTime() before playing the under-attack sound and then stores gameTime + 6.0f, so
# ae is that sound cooldown timestamp. The neighbouring accessor already reads
# getUnderAttackSound(GameScreen), which pins the naming convention.
# C / b(GameScreen,long) read and write field X: BuildPanelListener throttles with
# C() <= r() followed by X = r() + 1000000000L, i.e. one build action per second.
# E(GameScreen) exposes field v, the buffer MultiSelectPanelListener accumulates into before
# merging it into getSelectedUnits().
# j() and k() are cached switch maps, used as switch (j()[ammoType.ordinal()]) and
# switch (k()[birdType.ordinal()]).
# Left blank: r(GameScreen) / a(GameScreen,long) touch two DIFFERENT long fields (bK read, bM
# written) and no usage pins their meaning.
